rectangle.title: The Urban Minimalist
rectangle.look: Heavyweight white tee + Navy tapered chinos + White leather sneakers
rectangle.advice: Since you have a balanced frame, aim for a clean silhouette. Avoid oversized fits that hide your structure.
tips: Roll the chinos slightly at the ankle

rectangle.title: Weekend Explorer
rectangle.look: Olive green utility jacket + Grey melange sweatshirt + Dark wash denim
rectangle.advice: Texture layering adds depth to a rectangular build. The jacket provides masculine shoulder structure.

athletic.title: Athletic Edge
athletic.look: Fitted black henley + Khaki joggers + High-top sneakers
athletic.advice: Highlight your broad shoulders but keep the bottom relaxed to balance your proportions.
tips: Canvas cap for a sporty vibe

athletic.title: Sport Luxe
athletic.look: Bomber jacket + Slim-fit white tee + Performance trousers
athletic.advice: Bomber jackets accentuate your V-taper naturally. Keep the trousers slim but not tight to accommodate muscular legs.

apple.title: Smart Structure
apple.look: Vertical striped button-down (untucked) + Straight-leg dark jeans + Loafers
apple.advice: Vertical lines elongate your torso. Wearing the shirt untucked but structured hides the midsection without looking sloppy.
tips: Darker colors on top slim the torso

apple.title: Relaxed Layers
apple.look: Open flannel shirt + Charcoal t-shirt + Relaxed fit chinos
apple.advice: Layering an open shirt creates vertical lines that break up the midsection visually.

pear.title: Shoulder Focus
pear.look: Structured denim jacket + Crew neck tee + Dark straight-leg pants
pear.advice: Draw attention upwards. A stiff denim jacket adds bulk to your shoulders, balancing your wider hips.
tips: Light colors on top, dark on bottom
Chunky boots balance the leg width

pear.title: The Classic Fit
pear.look: Boat neck sweater + Regular fit trousers + Minimalist sneakers
pear.advice: A boat neck widens the shoulder line visually. Regular fit trousers don't cling to the hips.
tips: Push up sleeves to show forearms

hourglass.title: Tailored Casual
hourglass.look: Fitted polo shirt + Slim-straight jeans + Chelsea boots
hourglass.advice: Your balanced proportions allow for fitted styles. A polo complements your natural chest-to-waist ratio.
tips: Tuck in slightly at the front

hourglass.title: Monochrome Sleek
hourglass.look: Black turtleneck + Black slim chinos + Grey overcoat
hourglass.advice: Monochrome creates a seamless, tall line. The overcoat frames your balanced build perfectly.

rectangle.title: The Corporate Powerhouse
rectangle.look: Sky blue dress shirt + Charcoal trousers + Brown oxfords
rectangle.advice: A well-tailored shirt is key. Ensure the shoulder seams are perfect to avoid a boxy look.

rectangle.title: Business Creative
rectangle.look: Navy blazer + Grey turtleneck + Wool trousers
rectangle.advice: Replacing the shirt with a turtleneck adds volume to your frame and looks ultra-modern.

athletic.title: The V-Taper Suit
athletic.look: Made-to-measure Navy Suit + Crisp white shirt (no tie) + Loafers
athletic.advice: Off-the-rack suits often fail athletic builds. Ensure the jacket waist is taken in to show your drop.
tips: Skip the tie to show neck muscles

athletic.title: Smart Separates
athletic.look: Textured grey blazer + Black chinos + Derby shoes
athletic.advice: Separates work well for muscular legs as you can size pants independently from the jacket.

apple.title: Modern Executive
apple.look: Single-breasted dark suit + Vest/Waistcoat + Dark tie
apple.advice: A waistcoat creates a clean, flat surface over the midsection and looks incredibly sharp.

apple.title: Relaxed Friday
apple.look: Cardigan blazer + Gingham shirt + Comfort-waist trousers
apple.advice: Softer structured jackets (cardigan style) drape better over the midsection than stiff tailoring.

pear.title: The Upper Hand
pear.look: Double-breasted blazer + Flat front trousers + Brogues
pear.advice: Double-breasted jackets add significant width to the chest, perfectly balancing wider hips.

pear.title: Sharp Casual
pear.look: Structured trench coat + Button-down shirt + Dark denim
pear.advice: A trench coat with shoulder tabs (epaulets) draws the eye up and structures the frame.
tips: Tie the belt loosely at back

hourglass.title: The Italian Cut
hourglass.look: Slim-fit grey suit + White spread-collar shirt + Black tie
hourglass.advice: Italian cuts are naturally slimmer at the waist, perfect for your build.

hourglass.title: Modern Classic
hourglass.advice: Suspenders highlight a tapered waist better than a belt and add a vintage cool factor.

rectangle.title: Rockstar Chic
rectangle.look: Black leather jacket + White graphic tee + Ripped black jeans
rectangle.advice: Leather adds bulk and attitude. The monochrome base makes you look taller.

athletic.title: Muscle Fit
athletic.look: Short sleeve printed shirt + Tailored shorts + Loafers
athletic.advice: Show off the arms and legs. A bold print draws attention to your developed upper body.

apple.title: Dark & Dapper
apple.look: All-black ensemble: Black shirt + Black jeans + Charcoal blazer
apple.advice: Black is slimming and sophisticated. The blazer adds necessary structure.

pear.title: Statement Top
pear.look: Bold bomber jacket + Simple black tee + Dark tapered jeans
pear.advice: Let the jacket do the talking. It squares off your shoulders while dark jeans slim the hips.

hourglass.title: Vintage Cool
hourglass.advice: Fitted layers highlight your natural V-taper. Suede adds a rich, party-ready texture.

hourglass.title: Chic Parisian
hourglass.look: Wrap-around blouse + High-waisted straight jeans + Tan mules
hourglass.advice: Your waist is your best asset. The wrap top accentuates your natural curves perfectly without being restrictive.

hourglass.title: Vintage Denim
hourglass.look: Fitted bodysuit + Mom jeans + White sneakers
hourglass.advice: A bodysuit ensures no fabric bunching at the waist, highlighting your silhouette cleanly.

pear.title: Balanced boho
pear.look: Off-shoulder ruffled top + A-line midi skirt + Sandals
pear.advice: The off-shoulder neckline widens your shoulders to match your hips, creating perfect symmetry.

pear.title: Focus Up top
pear.look: Bright patterned blouse + Dark wash bootcut jeans + Ankle boots
pear.advice: Pattern on top draws the eye up. Bootcut jeans balance out wider hips effectively.

apple.title: The Empire Line
apple.look: Empire waist tunic + Slim-fit leggings + Ballet flats
apple.advice: The empire waist sits at your narrowest point (under the bust) and flows over the midsection.

apple.title: Structured flow
apple.look: Open waterfall cardigan + V-neck camisole + Straight leg jeans
apple.advice: Vertical lines from the cardigan and V-neck elongate the torso significantly.

rectangle.title: Curve Creator
rectangle.look: Peplum top + Skinny jeans + Pointed flats
rectangle.advice: A peplum top instantly creates the illusion of hips and a waist where there are none.

rectangle.title: Modern Classic
rectangle.look: Striped Breton top + Paperbag waist trousers + Canvas sneakers
rectangle.advice: The paperbag waist adds volume to hips and cinches the waist, creating shape.

athletic.title: Soft & Strong
athletic.look: Halter neck top + Wide-leg linen trousers + Slides
athletic.advice: Halter necks show off toned shoulders beautifully. Wide legs add volume to the lower body for balance.

athletic.title: Feminine Edge
athletic.look: Slip dress + Denim jacket tied at waist + White sneakers
athletic.advice: Tying a jacket at the waist breaks up the straight line and adds curve definition.

hourglass.title: The Executive Look
hourglass.look: Pencil skirt + Silk button-down + Pointed pumps
hourglass.advice: Structured pieces work best for professional settings while respecting your natural shape.

hourglass.title: Power Suit
hourglass.look: Belted blazer + Matching trousers + Silk camisole
hourglass.advice: A blazer with a built-in belt or cinched waist is ideal for maintaining your shape in a suit.

pear.title: Modern Professional
pear.look: Statement collar blouse + Wide-leg trousers + Block heels
pear.advice: Wide-leg trousers skim over hips and thighs comfortably. A statement collar draws eyes upward.

pear.title: Color Block
pear.look: Light colored blazer + Black sheath dress + Nude pumps
pear.advice: A light blazer widens the upper body. The black dress slims the lower body.

apple.title: Corporate Chic
apple.look: Shift dress + Open front blazer + Low heels
apple.advice: Shift dresses bypass the waistline completely for a comfortable, professional fit.

apple.title: Smart Comfort
apple.look: V-neck sweater + Mid-rise straight trousers + Loafers
apple.advice: V-necks open up the chest area. Straight trousers balance the silhouette.

rectangle.title: Structured Style
rectangle.advice: Double-breasted styles add width and shape to a straight torso.

rectangle.title: The Wrap Dress
rectangle.advice: The diagonal line of a wrap dress visually carves out a waistline for you.

athletic.title: Soft Tailoring
athletic.look: Silk blouse with bow + Pleated skirt + Kite heels
athletic.advice: Soft fabrics like silk and details like bows soften a strong, athletic frame.

athletic.title: The Wide Stride
athletic.advice: Shows off toned arms while adding significant volume and movement to the lower body.

hourglass.title: Evening Glamour
hourglass.look: Bodycon midi dress + Strappy heels + Clutch
hourglass.advice: Embrace the curves. A bodycon fit was literally made for your body type.

pear.title: Fit & Flare
pear.look: A-line cocktail dress + Statement necklace + Pumps
pear.advice: Fitted waist and flared skirt is the golden formula for pear shapes.

apple.title: Show Some Leg
apple.look: Swing dress (short) + Knee-high boots + Long necklace
apple.advice: Highlight your legs, which are usually a great asset for apple shapes.

rectangle.title: Cut-Out Queen
rectangle.look: Side cut-out maxi dress + Metallic heels
rectangle.advice: Side cut-outs create an artificial waistline that looks incredibly convincing.

athletic.title: Backless Beauty
athletic.advice: Show off that strong back. It is an elegant and unexpected way to reveal skin.

party.title: Evening Glamour
party.look: Monochrome dark ensemble + Statement jacket + Metallic accessories
party.advice: Focus on high-contrast textures like silk and leather for a premium night-out feel.
